name: exploded-grinder-claude-haiku-5.5-s1-r2
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a manual coffee grinder, as an SVG. Use a hand grinder with conical burrs rather than flat burrs.

grade.detail: failed: parts; left to the eye: order, fit, labels

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 1100" width="1000" height="1100" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="5" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#555"/>
    </marker>
    <pattern id="hatch" width="8" height="8" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(45)">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="8" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>
  <rect width="1000" height="1100" fill="#fff"/>
  <text x="40" y="45" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#222">Manual conical-burr coffee grinder – exploded assembly</text>
  <text x="40" y="70" font-size="14" fill="#555">Parts separated along the common axis; dotted lines show assembly alignment.</text>

  <!-- central axis -->
  <line x1="450" y1="95" x2="450" y2="1040" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="14,6 3,6"/>

  <!-- alignment guides -->
  <g stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,4">
    <line x1="450" y1="210" x2="450" y2="262"/>
    <line x1="450" y1="382" x2="450" y2="430"/>
    <line x1="450" y1="500" x2="450" y2="528"/>
    <line x1="450" y1="604" x2="450" y2="622"/>
    <line x1="450" y1="684" x2="450" y2="702"/>
    <line x1="450" y1="792" x2="450" y2="838"/>
    <line x1="450" y1="942" x2="450" y2="972"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 1 crank handle -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" fill="#d9b48a">
    <rect x="300" y="110" width="290" height="22" rx="10"/>
    <circle cx="590" cy="121" r="26" fill="#b5835a"/>
    <rect x="440" y="132" width="20" height="30" fill="#bbb"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="540" y1="90" x2="700" y2="90" stroke="#555"/>
  <text x="710" y="95" font-size="15" fill="#222">1  Crank handle with grip knob</text>
  <line x1="590" y1="95" x2="590" y2="98" stroke="none"/>

  <!-- 2 adjustment nut -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" fill="#c8c8c8">
    <rect x="390" y="165" width="120" height="45" rx="6"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#666" stroke-width="1">
    <line x1="404" y1="165" x2="404" y2="210"/><line x1="418" y1="165" x2="418" y2="210"/>
    <line x1="432" y1="165" x2="432" y2="210"/><line x1="468" y1="165" x2="468" y2="210"/>
    <line x1="482" y1="165" x2="482" y2="210"/><line x1="496" y1="165" x2="496" y2="210"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="510" y1="187" x2="700" y2="187" stroke="#555"/>
  <text x="710" y="192" font-size="15" fill="#222">2  Burr adjustment nut (grind size)</text>

  <!-- 3 hopper -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" fill="#eef4f8">
    <path d="M330,262 L570,262 L535,380 L365,380 Z"/>
    <ellipse cx="450" cy="262" rx="120" ry="10" fill="#dde8ef"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="560" y1="320" x2="700" y2="320" stroke="#555"/>
  <text x="710" y="325" font-size="15" fill="#222">3  Bean hopper (with lid)</text>

  <!-- 4 outer burr (ring, fixed) -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" fill="#777">
    <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M400,430 L500,430 L550,500 L350,500 Z M418,446 L482,446 L512,486 L388,486 Z"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="530" y1="465" x2="700" y2="465" stroke="#555"/>
  <text x="710" y="470" font-size="15" fill="#222">4  Outer conical burr (ring, fixed)</text>

  <!-- 5 inner conical burr (male, rotating) -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" fill="#4a4a4a">
    <path d="M345,604 L555,604 L490,530 L410,530 Z"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="1.2">
    <line x1="380" y1="600" x2="420" y2="532"/><line x1="415" y1="600" x2="440" y2="532"/>
    <line x1="450" y1="600" x2="460" y2="532"/><line x1="485" y1="600" x2="478" y2="532"/>
    <line x1="520" y1="600" x2="500" y2="532"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="555" y1="570" x2="700" y2="570" stroke="#555"/>
  <text x="710" y="575" font-size="15" fill="#222">5  Inner conical burr (male, turns)</text>

  <!-- 6 drive spindle -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" fill="#bbb">
    <rect x="438" y="622" width="24" height="62"/>
    <rect x="432" y="622" width="36" height="8" fill="#999"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="462" y1="652" x2="700" y2="652" stroke="#555"/>
  <text x="710" y="657" font-size="15" fill="#222">6  Drive spindle (square drive)</text>

  <!-- 7 main body / burr carrier -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" fill="#e2e2e2">
    <path d="M330,702 L570,702 L570,792 L330,792 Z"/>
    <rect x="350" y="712" width="200" height="60" fill="#f7f7f7"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="570" y1="745" x2="700" y2="745" stroke="#555"/>
  <text x="710" y="750" font-size="15" fill="#222">7  Main body (burr carrier, housing)</text>

  <!-- 8 grounds container -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" fill="#f2e6d0">
    <path d="M345,838 L555,838 L545,942 L355,942 Z"/>
    <ellipse cx="450" cy="838" rx="105" ry="8" fill="#e0cfae"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="550" y1="890" x2="700" y2="890" stroke="#555"/>
  <text x="710" y="895" font-size="15" fill="#222">8  Grounds container (catch cup)</text>

  <!-- 9 base cover -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" fill="#c9a77c">
    <rect x="320" y="972" width="260" height="30" rx="8"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="580" y1="987" x2="700" y2="987" stroke="#555"/>
  <text x="710" y="992" font-size="15" fill="#222">9  Base cover</text>

  <!-- rotation note -->
  <g stroke="#555" fill="none" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)">
    <path d="M300,121 Q270,121 270,95"/>
  </g>
  <text x="200" y="88" font-size="13" fill="#555">rotate</text>
  <text x="40" y="1060" font-size="14" fill="#444">Burrs: inner male cone (5) turns on spindle (6) inside fixed outer ring (4); gap set by nut (2).</text>
  <text x="40" y="1082" font-size="14" fill="#444">Parts are exploded along the central axis; they assemble from bottom to top.</text>
</svg>
